title: AWS AppSync to AWS Step Functions workflow catalog via Amazon EventBridge
description: A GraphQL front door that lets teams opt a Step Functions workflow in by tagging it, then any authorized caller triggers it by name and tracks it to completion.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This pattern puts a single AWS AppSync GraphQL API in front of your teams' Step Functions workflows. A workflow owner opts a Standard state machine in by tagging it 'workflowType'; a discovery Lambda (driven by CloudTrail events via Amazon EventBridge) registers it in a DynamoDB catalog, and an admin activates it by publishing a versioned JSON Schema input contract.

An authorized caller invokes the requestWorkflow mutation; a request-handler Lambda validates the caller and parameters, records the execution in a DynamoDB tracker, and publishes a 'Workflow Requested' event to a custom EventBridge bus. A trigger Lambda starts the state machine (StartExecution scoped by the workflowType tag). Step Functions status-change events update the tracker, and a scheduled reconciler Lambda repairs any dropped events. Callers poll getWorkflowExecution / listWorkflowExecutions. Authorization is IAM by default, with optional Amazon Cognito user-pool auth and per-workflow allowedCallers.

bullets.text: Build a GraphQL API with AWS AppSync

text: From the pattern directory, install dependencies: npm install
Bootstrap the account/Region if needed: npx cdk bootstrap
Build the Lambda bundle and deploy: npm run deploy (wraps cdk deploy; use this instead of a bare cdk deploy so the GraphQL schema and Lambda dependency are bundled)
See this pattern's README (Register a workflow / Test end to end) for how to register a workflow and confirm it runs.
